chars.NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan young man of 18 with short curly black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.BROTHER: a heavy Moroccan man of 32 with a thick black moustache and stubble, wearing a grey work overall stained with paint
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman of 28 with a bright red headscarf tied loosely, wearing a purple satin djellaba, gold hoop earrings, heavy eyeliner
chars.MOM: a kind Moroccan woman of 55 with a white headscarf and a light green house djellaba

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse courtyard near Kasba Tadla: WIFE stands with hands on hips shouting angrily with her mouth wide open, pointing a finger, while BROTHER sits on a low stool behind her looking down, embarrassed; whitewashed walls, a clothesline, warm afternoon light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, rural Moroccan kitchen with a clay tagine on a gas burner: WIFE smiles sweetly and hands NARRATOR a glass of mint tea, NARRATOR looks surprised and pleased; cozy, warm light

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, a Moroccan family gathering in a farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, a low round table with a big couscous plate and tea tray; MOM sits in the middle smiling, NARRATOR, BROTHER and WIFE sit around; festive, relaxed

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, same Moroccan salon: WIFE stands up shouting furiously at MOM, raising one hand as if about to slap her; MOM leans back on the banquette, shocked and scared, hand on her chest; tea glasses tipped over on the table

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, same Moroccan salon: close shot of NARRATOR turning his head to stare at BROTHER with wide expectant eyes, waiting for him to react; BROTHER sits frozen holding a tea glass

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, warm memory scene in a Moroccan farmhouse doorway: NARRATOR kisses MOM's forehead respectfully, MOM smiles proudly; soft golden light, olive tree in the background

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, Moroccan salon: BROTHER sits with his head bowed low in shame, shoulders slumped, staring at the floor, while WIFE stands next to him with arms crossed looking triumphant

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, Moroccan salon: NARRATOR sits with clenched fists and an angry frown, glaring at BROTHER who avoids his eyes and looks away

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, Moroccan salon full of relatives watching in shock: WIFE leans over MOM shouting loudly with an angry face, MOM covers her face with her hands; relatives in the background with hands over mouths
